title: Reaper Project Bounce Failure Hotspots
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:project project_template=* bounce_failed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(bounce_failed="yes",1,0))) as matched by project_template
| eval a_failed_bounce_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_failed_bounce_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Reaper export attempts that end with a failed bounce by project template.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which project template are helping or hurting Reaper export attempts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a failed bounce` on `music:project` events and summarize the hit rate by `project_template`.
visualization: Table of project template with percentage of Reaper export attempts ending with a failed bounce.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often a failed bounce happens for each project template so you can see where Reaper export attempts go smoothly or get stuck.
